rationale: C01 is the strongest plausible template because it concerns the same carrier, the same employee representative (allowing for the union's updated AFL-CIO designation and division name), and reproduces nearly the entire recital-and-operative structure of the child. The child removes C01's Defense Production Act provision and makes minor stylistic updates, but retains the same Railway Labor Act findings, thirty-day reporting requirement, and status-quo mandate. C24 and C04 are close later examples of the standardized machinery, but they concern different airlines and unions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pan American World Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, AFL-CIO, Air Transport Division
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pan American World Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, CIO
shared_material.explanation: The directives address the same carrier-union relationship using nearly identical opening language, with an updated union affiliation and division designation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce
shared_material.explanation: The central statutory and factual recitals are reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The operative reporting instruction is identical apart from deletion of 'said.'

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pan American World Airways, Inc., or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement shall be made by the Pan American World Airways, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same status-quo mechanism is applied to the same parties for the same statutory period, with only punctuation and minor wording changes.
